components.css: .ds-button-primary{display:inline-flex;min-height:46px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;padding:10px 19px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:7px;font-family:'Nunito Sans', sans-serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.5;text-decoration:none;transition:background-color 180ms ease-out,border-color 180ms ease-out;color:var(--ng-doc-primary-text,#fff);background:var(--landing-accent, var(--ng-doc-primary, #0c6cbd));}.ds-button-primary svg{width:19px;height:19px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;}.ds-button-primary:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--landing-accent, var(--ng-doc-primary, #0c6cbd)) 85%,var(--landing-ink, var(--ng-doc-heading-color, #172b3a)));}.ds-button-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--landing-accent, var(--ng-doc-primary, #0c6cbd));outline-offset:5px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-primary{transition:none;}}

components.name: Installation Command
components.description: Angular CLI setup with ng add @workletjs/ngx-openlayers. The static note keeps version compatibility visible. A green check with a 12% success tint and 2.4px stroke confirms copying; root NgDocNotifyService presents success or failure in a bottom viewport overlay for two seconds. The clipped polite live region and overlay cause no layout shift. The copy target is 44px square below 800px. This preview shows the copied state.
components.html:
$ng add @workletjs/ngx-openlayers

Check version compatibility before installing.

Command copied. Your first map is next.
components.css: .ds-install{display:flex;min-height:58px;max-width:450px;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px 10px 10px 16px;border:1px solid var(--landing-line, var(--ng-doc-border-color, #dbe4eb));border-radius:7px;background:var(--landing-surface, var(--ng-doc-base-1, #f4f7fa));color:var(--landing-ink, var(--ng-doc-heading-color, #172b3a));}.ds-prompt{color:var(--landing-muted, var(--ng-doc-text, #586774));font-family:'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;font-size:13px;user-select:none;}.ds-command{min-width:0;font-family:'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;font-size:12px;line-height:1.8;overflow-wrap:anywhere;}.ds-copy{display:grid;width:36px;height:36px;flex-shrink:0;place-items:center;margin-left:auto;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:4px;color:var(--landing-muted, var(--ng-doc-text, #586774));background:transparent;cursor:pointer;}.ds-copy svg{width:19px;height:19px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;}.ds-copy:hover{color:var(--landing-accent, var(--ng-doc-primary, #0c6cbd));background:var(--landing-paper, var(--ng-doc-base-0, #fff));}.ds-copy.is-copied{color:var(--landing-success, var(--ng-doc-success, #15803d));background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--landing-success, var(--ng-doc-success, #15803d)) 12%,transparent);}.ds-copy.is-copied svg{stroke-width:2.4;}.ds-copy:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--landing-accent, var(--ng-doc-primary, #0c6cbd));outline-offset:5px;}.ds-copy:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:wait;}.ds-compat{min-height:20px;margin-top:8px;font-size:12px;color:var(--landing-muted, var(--ng-doc-text, #586774));}.ds-compat a{color:var(--landing-accent, var(--ng-doc-primary, #0c6cbd));text-underline-offset:4px;}.ds-copy-feedback{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;margin:-1px;padding:0;border:0;clip-path:inset(50%);white-space:nowrap;}@media(max-width:800px){.ds-copy{width:44px;height:44px;}}

components.name: Location Presets
components.description: Alps, London, and Tokyo buttons start with the Alps selected at zoom 9 and expose selection derived from the current center and zoom; a freely moved view has no pressed preset. Narrow-screen targets are at least 44px square. Below 640px the map font is 32px, making OpenLayers’ native 1.375em zoom controls 44px without changing the attribution text size.
components.css: .ds-locations{display:flex;gap:2px;}.ds-location{min-height:32px;padding:5px 10px;border:0;border-radius:5px;background:transparent;color:var(--landing-muted, var(--ng-doc-text, #586774));cursor:pointer;font-family:'Nunito Sans', sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.65;transition:color 160ms ease,background-color 160ms ease;}.ds-location:hover{background:var(--landing-surface, var(--ng-doc-base-1, #f4f7fa));color:var(--landing-ink, var(--ng-doc-heading-color, #172b3a));}.ds-location[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--landing-surface, var(--ng-doc-base-1, #f4f7fa));color:var(--landing-accent, var(--ng-doc-primary, #0c6cbd));}.ds-location:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--landing-accent, var(--ng-doc-primary, #0c6cbd));outline-offset:-2px;}@media(max-width:640px){.ds-location{min-width:44px;min-height:44px;padding-inline:9px;}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-location{transition:none;}}

narrative.overview:
This local system describes the Landing components in this directory. It inherits the NgDoc theme through the custom properties recorded above. The visual character is clear, practical developer documentation: Nunito Sans, paper surfaces, quiet rules, a blue action color, and a deep ink-blue code dock.

The working OpenStreetMap preview and its synchronized Angular template provide the visual evidence. Type and spacing make installation and the First Map path easy to scan. The map is live content; the implementation adds no decorative raster imagery.
keyCharacteristics: Strong, compact headings with readable supporting copy.
Flat sections, fine dividers, and modestly rounded controls.
A live map connected to readable Angular code.

rules.name: The Theme Inheritance Rule
rules.body: Use the existing NgDoc property with its recorded fallback for Landing surfaces and controls. Keep the dock's implemented syntax palette intact.

dos: Do preserve NgDoc color inheritance and the recorded fallbacks.
Do keep the map, location presets, and displayed Angular values synchronized.
Do retain keyboard outlines, selectable code, and copy-status feedback.
Do preserve the single-column reading order on narrow screens.
donts: Don't add decorative gradients or a card grid to this Landing surface.
Don't substitute a static image for the working map demonstration.
Don't add entrance animation; honor reduced motion for existing control transitions.
Don't treat this local document as a design contract for the surrounding app shell.
